tabs.note: One competency per rung of the ladder, because the ladder is the part that needs showing: generalised (mastery, then held after two weeks away), mastered (four unassisted inside a week), stable (three in a row but one prompted, so the unaided run never reaches four), practising (two in a row), exposed (attempted, never yet correct — the rung that proves the screen tells 'not attempted' apart from 'attempted and not there yet'). skill_id must name a row of example_skills.

tabs.note: status must be one of TRIP_STATUSES (Travel.gs). Variance is COMPUTED from budget against actual, so only the completed trip carries both — zero against zero is not 'on budget', it is 'nobody has said'. decided_at filled is what makes the trip carry a decider. READ THIS BEFORE EDITING: travelTrips_ (Travel.gs) drops every EX_ id before the Business Travel screen sees it — a standing instruction to keep the examples off that screen. The rows are written, removed by id and visible in raw sheet mode, but editing this tab does NOT change what Business Travel shows until the filter is lifted. apps-script/Examples.gs names it in EX_HIDDEN_RESOURCES and the verdict holds the two in step.
